name: Hermione Granger
life: Quant developer at a trading firm. Uses keyboard shortcuts for everything, exports to CSV, double-checks every number against her own Python notebook.
aesthetic: Information density done right (think Bloomberg meets Linear). Wants ⌘K, keyboard nav, exact numbers on hover. Rages at spinners and layout shift.
strategy: Monthly $3,000 rebalanced into a diversified sleeve including 10% BTC; buys QQQ on 5% five-day dips; harvests losses with substitutes.
